_doc: Board qualification is derived: every protection type in the graph (including LSID) must compile without refusals and be in this build's units_at_parity, the silent DT/tuning wiring self-check must pass for this board, blob hash and kernel release, and the verified extraction record must bind the tuning to this Mac's own macOS. Missing, failed or stale records keep the speakers muted on v2 kernels. denied_boards and board_overrides (allow/deny) are policy only: deny wins, and allow never bypasses compilation, parity, provenance or self-check. Provisioning and self-check may run before qualification; only a current qualified record admits the supervisor. LSID is not at parity: K114/K116 remain muted.
_voicing_pre_doc: Full generated voicing deployment overrides per physical board: literal true enables it, false keeps the interim convolver. At runtime a board without an override automatically compiles its own full chain; offline fixture artifacts retain their recorded mode. SPP3V owns promotion after numerical/acoustic qualification. Provision again after any change.
_voicing_pre_bound_doc: 2026-11-08 Plan A RC (bound.py on the full-chain safety scan of the RC tree; M2 with the exact LowFlow build; j700 from the AID44 voicing VLS): j316s -0.097, j413 0.0, j616s 0.0, j700 0.0 dB. A 0 means that board has no deployment trim. The former j413 woofer -0.883 dB bound was derived against a reference renderer that omitted AULowFlow property 6620; the propstrip-correct installed-chain reference clears every steps row (worst steady +0.0020 dB, transient +0.0059 dB), so that invalid interim bound is removed. History: Interim never-louder bound (Ryan 2026-11-07: Plan A tonight on all four boards, open laws in their never-louder form): one gain in dB per unit lane, applied by the PipeWire voicing graph after the voicing plugin. Derived from the full-chain safety scan (packaging: bound.py = worst louder excess + 0.03 dB, L/R pairs equal) for j316s/j413/j616s and from the AID44 voicing-level VLS gate for j700; protection is unchanged and governs.
_voicing_pre_lowpass_doc: INTERIM never-louder band limit, not a macOS law (AUD-CUT2 2026-11-07, Ryan's parity rule: never-louder is fine as interim). {hz, order}: an even-order Butterworth low-pass built from PipeWire bq_lowpass sections in FRONT of the voicing plugin. j700 only: v2's AID44 ControlFreak lacks the AU's reconstruction low-pass, so above ~17 kHz the box is up to +23 dB (+30 dB at 0 dBFS) louder than macOS and its saturation aliases a loud high-frequency input into 9-16.5 kHz; the lane trim cannot hold either. 17.4 kHz order 8 (with the j700 trim): AID44 box rig (installed AU, 362 tones/pink/steps incl. 16-23.75 kHz probes) 0 louder cases, worst -0.58 dB; full AID44 voicing VLS 30 Hz-19.5 kHz 0 louder bands, worst -0.03 dB; cost at 16 kHz -0.1 dB. Goes when the ControlFreak law is exact (Daybreak t-5511). 2026-11-08: no board carries it; the AID44 ControlFreak saturation, reconstruction and drive laws are exact on the box rig (steady and 20 kHz), so the j700 trim alone (-0.35 dB from the AID44 VLS, worst +0.311) holds.
